reason: Search variants and frozen-policy-head continuation failed development gates. Compare full-network continuation and value-only learning with the same fixed-size network and original data.

data.policy: Reuse only original teacher training/validation partitions; no reported game, previous diagnostic holdout, screen games or future independent matches in learning.

training.trainable: per-arm: all120905 parameters or value head only; value-only must preserve every other tensor exactly
training.selection: Lowest common validation loss at epochs0/2/4/6/8 including baseline epoch0; no result-driven recipe changes.

tests: Value-only mode preserves every non-value tensor; full mode permits backbone updates; all modes retain architecture and feature ABI
refresh-surprise weights preserve domain mass and eligibility
PyTorch/ONNX/WGSL golden and actual9-board Worker parity

development.selection: At most one eligible candidate with highest total score; ties use AllUniform, AllPriority, ValueUniform order.

matches.seed: FNV1a32(phaseSeed|board|pair|ply); independently seeded xorshift opening sampler; same opening and per-ply seed for both colours and variants
matches.moveCap: 6*N; retain capped games; no outcome-dependent seed replacement
matches.score: actual Game area score, komi6.5, draw half point

latency.fixture: First development colour1 game per board at N/4,N/2,3N/4, plus predefined reported/pass/certified-loss stress roots; freeze before timing.

stress.reason: Predeclared absolute tolerance for very short roots motivated by the previous 1.3ms outlier; applies only to new measurements and does not change the previous study verdict.

latency.condition: quiet environment, alternating order, includes restore/search/normal yields; no diagnostic logging

scope: Compare three newly registered learning scopes, same120905-parameter model and original A8 search at64 visits. No post-outcome recipe changes; only one independent432-game candidate. No hosted deployment.
stopping: If neither training arm passes preflight/development, archive negative results. Independent or speed failure retains deployed baseline. A passing candidate can be integrated locally only after all correctness and PC latency checks.
